now.title: Logan
now.text: In 2029, an aging Logan protects Laura, kills X-24, and dies in her arms near the border.

proposed.text: In 2029, an aging Logan protects Laura until X-24 impales him, and Laura kills X-24 with the adamantium bullet. Logan dies in her arms near the border.

changes.evidence: Logan (2017): X-24 impales Logan on a tree branch; Laura loads Logan's revolver with the adamantium bullet and shoots X-24 in the head, killing him. Logan does not kill X-24.

now.title: Dark Phoenix
now.text: Storm fights Jean in New York, then defends the mutants from the D'Bari on the train.
cases: FX-024 The D'Bari Attack on the Prison Train (Dark Phoenix)

proposed.text: Storm strikes at Jean at her childhood home, fights Magneto's mutants in New York, then defends the mutants from the D'Bari on the train.

changes.evidence: Dark Phoenix: Storm fires lightning at Jean at the Grey home in Red Hook (where Jean kills Raven); in New York City she fights Selene and Ariki of Erik's faction, not Jean.
